description: Source code for the FastAPI router handling CRUD operations and sharing functionality for notes. Defines endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, sharing, and accessing shared notes, along with supporting helper functions for sanitization and model conversion.

classes.description: Pydantic model for note response data

classes.name: NotesListResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for paginated list of notes

classes.name: ShareRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for sharing a note
